title: The Share of a Circle Live Balance Released in One Redemption
content:
Only a share of the live balance on a Northbeam Circle Membership may be released in one redemption, and
which share follows the redemptions standing in the twelve months ending on the handling day and the standing of
the membership.

## The share

1. Where a transfer out stands in the twelve months ending on the handling day and the membership stands active,
   the share released is the transfer share of this schedule, 0.5 of the live balance, 50 percent.
2. Where no transfer out stands in that window, a redemption of another kind stands in it and the membership
   stands active, the share released is the other redemption share of this schedule, 0.75 of the live balance,
   75 percent.
3. Where neither of those holds, the whole of the live balance may be released, a share of 1.

## Which redemptions count

A transfer out is a redemption taking the form of points moved to another profile. A redemption of another kind
is any other form a redemption takes. The first reading is reached on one transfer out inside the window,
whatever else stands there; the second is reached only where no transfer out stands inside it.

| Transfer out in the 12 months | Another kind of redemption in the window | Standing | Share released |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Active | 0.5 |
| Yes | No | Active | 0.5 |
| No | Yes | Active | 0.75 |
| No | No | Active | The whole balance |
| Yes | Yes | Not active | The whole balance |

## Worked share on a hypothetical balance

On a live balance of 21600 points, the first reading leaves 10800 points releasable, the second 16200 points
and the third the whole 21600. A live balance of nothing leaves nothing releasable under any of the three
readings.
